method: Crosswalk separately published self-logged production hours, owner-only educational watch-time reports and public engagement counts. Quality is a measurement question, not a ranked index; cohort means/medians are not combined across sources. Separately incorporate a published manual GQS/modified DISCERN expert review of relevance-ranked statistics videos; compare only within its own search-selected denominator.
population: One selected photography creator's completed work diary, three educational-video engagement/retention studies, and one relevance-selected expert-rated statistics-video study; none is representative of creator profits or platform learning.

dimensions.meaning: Self-logged creation time by production stage, not an aesthetic or instructional quality scale
Owner-observed average duration and retention, conditioned on reached viewers; not causal instructional quality
Public views, likes and comments reflect selected exposures, not lesson correctness or viewer satisfaction
Third-party content use may trigger Content ID; rights checks are distinct from production craft
Requires a defined consented learner outcome or satisfaction instrument; cannot be read from view events
Would require matched receipts, eligibility, royalties, paid labor, costs, rights deductions and failures
Video content clarity, completeness and reliability rated by subject experts using the Global Quality Scale and modified DISCERN, not direct learner examination or observed attention
Descriptive visible production style across selected statistics videos: slides, narration, animation and software demonstration; format alone does not establish audience satisfaction or quality

bounded_observations.within_study_signal: Within one selected channel, dissemination and under-eight-minute videos showed stronger reported retention than comparison formats; observational association only.
Instructional items had higher sampled views/shares; practice-test items had higher likes and watch-time measures; neither is randomized.
The selected high-view math videos showed no significant reported link of duration with these public engagement metrics.

bounded_observations.sampled_videos_source_population: English statistics-related search results selected from top 50 relevance-sorted results for each of four queries
bounded_observations.expert_rating_definition: Global Quality Scale 1–5 (high 4–5; intermediate 3; low 1–2) and modified DISCERN reliability tool
bounded_observations.within_study_signal: Expert content-quality classifications describe 87 of 114 selected English search-result videos as high quality (76.3%), not the prevalence of accurate tutorials across YouTube. Study also coded 45 slides, 24 narrated, 29 animated and 16 software demonstration formats.
cautions: Search ranking and English language selection are biased toward visible, eligible videos; the first 200 URLs are not an unrestricted upload population.
Expert content review is not evidence of tested learner outcomes or financial return.
The other four production/workload and engagement samples are independent measurement questions but not confirmed deduplicated content.
Viewer comments, watch minutes, expert quality and producer labor hours cannot be pooled into one universal ranking.

matching_requirements: Define education or entertainment format and topic independently of outcome ranking
Record channel age, subscriber band and language before matched comparisons
Use a fixed publication/observation window and comparable Shorts versus long-form surfaces
Capture measured owner-only retention separately from public likes and views
Separate completed projects and abandoned drafts including non-published labor
Record authorized media rights, editing accessibility, production cash cost and creator labor without double-counting
Use independent learner outcome or defined satisfaction survey before claiming measured instructional quality
Never pool unaligned cross-study samples to infer typical YouTube creator hours or quality

If educational content quality is the outcome, use a documented blinded expert rubric and a fixed genre/language/search-result population, and separate it from production hours, views and actual learning.
prohibited_conclusions: The four samples' video counts are a single pooled estimate of YouTube quality
9.74 hours is typical production time or an optimal quality threshold
Higher likes, watch time or video length proves better instruction or profitability
Selected channel engagement is representative of new channel success probabilities
A rights claim is evidence of poor quality or of a measured loss of net profit
87 of 114 high-rated selected statistics search-result videos means 76.3% of all YouTube tutorials are high quality or lucrative.
